opening.argument: The presentation advances OneCoin as a cryptocurrency and online money-making opportunity by describing increasing value, trading profits, and member profits. It directs viewers toward registration through the stated destination, “Sponsored by https://www.onecoin.eu/signup/currencycrypto Register Free Today!”, while the accompanying material urges a $1,100 coin purchase. Its product-line page further presents paid education and trader packages, with prices ranging from at least 500 EUR to 5000 EUR, and tokens supplied with package purchases. The training material describes profit for beginners and unlimited income through cryptocurrency trading. These are concrete invitations to purchase and register in pursuit of appreciation or earnings. The material does not establish, however, that any payment or registration occurred, or that any promised outcome was achieved.
